summary.en: Shout, and your voice bursts into comic-book onomatopoeia on screen — joined by QR, measured on-device, audio never leaves the phone.
summary.jp: 叫ぶと声が擬音になって画面に弾ける。QR で参加する VJ で、音声は端末から出ない。

mine: Designed a voice-triggered VJ that turns shouts into on-screen onomatopoeia
Built on-device audio measurement so no audio ever leaves the phone
Built the QR-join Snap Pair flow and canvas rendering

challenge.en: Voice party games either need accounts and mics in the cloud, or they punish quiet rooms. We needed on-device loudness that feels fair in a living room — and readable even when nobody reads instructions.
challenge.jp: 声のパーティーゲームはクラウドのマイクとアカウントを要するか、静かな部屋を罰しがち。リビングで公平に感じる端末内の音量判定と、説明を読まなくても分かるゲームが必要だった。

solution.en: Koe Baku scores peak loudness locally and mirrors outcomes on the big screen via snap-pair. Roles are visible in the room, not buried in UI. The decisive move was making volume a shared spectacle, not a settings panel.
solution.jp: Koe Baku は端末内でピーク音量を採点し、Snap Pair で大画面に結果を映す。役割は UI の奥ではなく部屋で見える。決定打は、音量を設定画面ではなく共有の見せ場にすること。

cardLine.en: A party game you play by shouting at the shared screen.
cardLine.jp: 共有画面に向かって叫んで遊ぶパーティーゲーム。
